row_guide: Band0 (y0–768): hedge walls plain+flowered styles 1–2, arches, bushes, potted/tiered/spiral topiary, animal topiaries (bear/elephant/horse/cat), iron gates; putto/angel statues, wall basins, maiden fountains, tiered fountains, grey/brown statues; red/blue vases empty+flowered; rakes/shovels/watering cans by color, shears; birdhouses big/little by color; pillars full/broken/modular; pergola structure/roof/fence; wood carts big/small empty/full, wood boxes; storage sheds brown/white/blue/red variants; benches big/med/small/square/decorated. Band1 (y768–1536): greenhouse examples small/large, see-through, overgrown, interior; structure/glass/floor/roof/door/window modular layers; wood decks, ladders, shelves; flowers+vases sunflower/red/pink/white/yellow/light-blue at big/med/small; sprouts+vases growth stages; pots, hanging vines, blue cans, hand tools, garden stairs. Band2 (y1536–2304): palace see-through frames; grand conservatory/palace facade example with skylights, roof ornaments, arched windows, balconies, columns; vined angel statues light/dark; vined figure statues blue/tan; door frames. Band3 (y2304–3072): manor main facade + roof topdown, skylights, dormers, roof caps; arched/rect/circle windows, balconies, columns, entrance; wide stairs + globe ornaments; palace entrance variants 1–2. Band4 (y3072–3136): brown facade strips plain / 4-col / 2-col / arch alcove; doormat, ground lights, white columns.
